meta.name: chrome-history
meta.description: Query Chrome browsing history with natural language. Filter by date range, article type, keywords, and specific sites.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自然语言查询你的Chrome浏览记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从大量浏览历史中快速找到之前看过的页面
copy.tagline_en: Query your Chrome browsing history with natural language
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find a previously visited page from your browsing history

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能查询你的 Chrome 浏览历史。你可以用自然语言指定日期、关键词、网站或文章类型，Claude 会返回按类别分组的链接列表。
howto.when: 当你询问关于浏览历史的问题时触发，例如要求查看昨天读过的文章或上周访问的网站。

say.note: 返回昨天浏览的新闻、博客等阅读类页面。

say.text: 上周看了什么科学论文？
say.note: 返回上周访问的研究类页面。

say.text: 上个月逛过的 Reddit 帖子
say.note: 返回上个月 reddit.com 的浏览记录。

howto.what_en: Claude can query your Chrome browsing history using natural language. You can filter by date, keywords, site, or content type, and get results grouped by category with links.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about your browsing history, e.g., articles read yesterday or sites visited last week.

say_en.text: What articles did I read yesterday?
What scientific papers did I look at last week?
say_en.note: Returns research pages from last week.

say_en.text: Show me Reddit threads from last month
say_en.note: Returns reddit.com history from last month.
